Trumbeak

Normal Flying

Alola · Generation 7

Trumbeak is a Normal/Flying-type Bugle Beak Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 14.8 kg. It evolves from Pikipek and into Toucannon. Its highest base stat is Attack (85), with a base stat total of 355.
